def validate_port(value: str) -> int:
    """A TCP port: ASCII digits only, 1 to 65535, trimmed."""
    cleaned = value.strip()
    if not cleaned or not all("0" <= ch <= "9" for ch in cleaned):
        raise ValidationError("port must be digits only")
    port = int(cleaned)
    if not 1 <= port <= 65535:
        raise ValidationError("port must be 1 to 65535")
    return port
